sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the static requirement: ship-targeted localControlItem values are linked through hasLocalControlItem, and each localControlItem requires both canonical boolean properties to have the inclusive value true. Datatypes, owners, paths, namespace, and applicability are correct; no additional existence constraint is required for the universal rule.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace nltl:freezingSnowIceProtectionPresent with the supplied canonical nltl:localControlProtectionPresent property. The authoritative metadata assigns freezingSnowIceProtectionPresent to the ship owner, so placing it on each localControlItem violates its declared owner and targets the wrong entity; localControlProtectionPresent is the localControlItem-owned protection requirement.
